facts.text: For sandwich orders, Lehr’s invites customers to call 513-831-3411 ahead to reduce the wait. Confirm the collection point and any assistance needed; the page does not describe vehicle-side handoff.
quote: Alleviate your wait… Please call in your order. It will be ready when you are!

facts.text: The sandwich service is listed as Monday–Saturday 11 a.m.–5 p.m. and Sunday 11 a.m.–4 p.m.; these are sandwich-service hours, not the market’s full opening hours.
facts.quote: Prime Sandwiches are served Mon. – Sat. 11 a.m. – 5 p.m. Sunday 11 a.m. – 4 p.m.

facts.text: The sandwich menu invites customers to ask about gluten-free bread options. This does not establish ingredients, cross-contact controls or suitability for a particular allergy.

facts.text: For Thanksgiving 2026, orders can be placed in person, by phone at 513-831-3411 or through the linked online ordering page. The posted online deadline is November 19 at 11:59 p.m.; later walk-ins depend on item availability.

name: Boone County Drive-Thru Food Pantry
address_quote: 3819 Turfway Rd, Erlanger, KY, 41018, United States

facts.text: The pantry says guests remain in their vehicles while volunteers load the food. This describes food loading, not assistance with moving or transferring a person.
facts.quote: Guests remain in their vehicles while volunteers load their food.

facts.text: The pantry says it welcomes people beyond Boone County and requires neither an appointment nor documentation.
facts.quote: You do not have to be a Boone County resident—everyone is welcome, and no appointment or documentation is necessary.

facts.text: The regular pantry session is the second Saturday of each month, 9–11 a.m. Check with the organizer for changes before travelling.
facts.quote: The pantry is open on the second Saturday of every month from 9:00–11:00 AM.

facts.text: The pantry is a partnership of Christ’s Chapel and Immanuel Methodist Church. Christ’s Chapel’s page gives 3819 Turfway Road in Erlanger and 859-371-3787 as its contact location and phone.
quote: The Boone County Drive-Thru Food Pantry is a partnership between Christ’s Chapel and Immanuel Methodist Church
3819 Turfway Rd, Erlanger, KY, 41018, United States

name: Action Ministries — Covington Grocery Pantry
address_quote: Action Ministries 4375 Boron Dr Covington, KY, 41015

facts.text: The pantry serves Kenton, Boone, Campbell, Grant and Pendleton counties and applies a household-income eligibility scale. Confirm the current income limit with the pantry; the displayed table has no stated effective year.
quote: Our service area is Kenton, Boone, Campbell, Grant & Pendleton counties
We use the USDA Food Program Income Eligibility Scale

facts.text: For a first visit, the pantry asks eligible households to bring two items showing the applicant’s name and current address, plus identification for every household member. Examples include mail, bills or a driver’s licence for address evidence and school ID, a medical card or a birth certificate for household identification.
quote: If you fall within these two guidelines, then please bring the following items with you on your first visit:
Two pieces of ID with your name and current address (mail, bills, driver’s license, etc.)
ID for all members of your household (SS card, medical card, birth certificate, school ID, etc.)

facts.text: The first-visit instructions ask newcomers to arrive by 11:30 a.m. to allow registration before noon. Because the same page also lists evening sessions without first-visit instructions for them, confirm evening registration by phone.
quote: Please plan to arrive at our office no later than 11:30 if it is your first visit.
It will take several minutes to get you set up and into our system and we like to allow our volunteers to go home at noon.
First and Third Monday of the Month from 6:00-7:00 pm

facts.text: Published service hours are Monday–Friday 9 a.m.–noon and the first and third Monday evenings of the month, 6–7 p.m., with closure on major holidays.
facts.quote: Service Hours (closed on all major holidays) Monday through Friday from 9am to noon First and Third Monday of the Month from 6:00-7:00 pm

facts.text: In bad weather, the pantry asks visitors to call 859-261-3649 for an updated recording if it is closed.
facts.quote: In case of bad weather, please call our office (859-261-3649) for a recording which will be updated if we are closed because of bad weather.

facts.text: The contact page places the pantry at 4375 Boron Drive in Covington and gives 859-261-3649 for visit questions.
quote: Action Ministries 4375 Boron Dr Covington, KY, 41015
